nodes.label: Buyer Profile feature module (web/src/features/profile)
nodes.rationale: Gives buyers a dedicated account hub to edit name, update security credentials and see reservation statistics, aligned with the design system and 200-line limit.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Base UI base-nova preset
nodes.rationale: A consistent shadcn component system across buyer screens while keeping the landing page design intact.

nodes.label: Cart drawer (floating button and right-side sheet)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the cart page so cart access is available without leaving marketplace or order pages.

nodes.label: Decimal quantity text-draft entry
nodes.rationale: Keeps a text draft while typing and commits a valid number on blur to fix decimal quantity entry.

nodes.label: design-taste-frontend skill (leonxlnx/taste-skill)
nodes.rationale: Makes requested frontend design guidance available in the workspace for future UI work.

nodes.label: 200-line source file limit
nodes.rationale: Encourages readable, focused files; oversized files are split following project module conventions. Recorded in AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Typography Alignment and Icon Harmonization (delivery note)
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-26 Typography Alignment and Icon Harmonization.md

nodes.label: Manrope headings and Inter body typography
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-26 Typography Alignment and Icon Harmonization.md
nodes.rationale: Project-mandated typefaces wired through Next.js layout, Tailwind config and tokens.css for cohesive typography.

nodes.label: Header and profile icon size normalization
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-26 Typography Alignment and Icon Harmonization.md
nodes.rationale: Eliminates disproportionate button and icon sizing (size-12 to size-9, 16px icons) across buyer header and profile.

nodes.label: Seller analytics reserved quantity by creation period
nodes.rationale: Analytics showed zero reserved units when reservations had changed state; now counts reservations created in the period and keeps pending quantity separate.

nodes.label: Groq analytics summary (openai/gpt-oss-20b, GROQ_TIMEOUT_MS)
nodes.rationale: Default model switched from inaccessible llama-3.3-70b-versatile; failures were silently collapsed so safe diagnostics and configurable timeout were added.

nodes.label: Mobile visibility card aligned to backend fields (postingAge, remainingQuantity, recurrence)
nodes.rationale: The card read fields the backend did not return, producing NaN% output.

nodes.label: Listing-scoped buyer questions and seller replies
Monitor-only admin policy with weighted trust points
nodes.rationale: The admin workflow stays automated and monitoring-only; admins cannot review, dismiss, warn, restrict or suspend a user. Allegations are counted separately from weighted points.

nodes.label: Private report evidence uploads and short-lived downloads
Q10 shelf-life planning estimate (later removed)
nodes.rationale: Required inventory age and a sourced SHELF_LIFE_REFERENCES_JSON record; numeric estimates stayed unavailable without approved crop values.

nodes.label: Buyer Profile Header Sign Out Removal (delivery note)
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 Buyer Profile Header Sign Out Removal.md

nodes.label: Redundant profile-header Sign out button removal
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 Buyer Profile Header Sign Out Removal.md
nodes.rationale: Justified by Hick-Hyman Law, Von Restorff Effect and Dieter Rams's 'as little design as possible'; sign-out remains in global navigation.

nodes.label: Seller product sharing (Share.share and clipboard fallback)
ProductDetailsScreen React hook order fix
nodes.rationale: Sharing state hook moved above early returns to stop the 'Rendered more hooks' runtime error.

nodes.label: Mobile Login and Marketplace Visibility Fix (delivery note)

nodes.label: EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED login triggers verification OTP
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 Mobile Login and Marketplace Visibility Fix.md
nodes.rationale: Unverified accounts were rejected before the login screen reached its OTP dispatch branch.

nodes.label: isMarketable data correction for seller products
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 Mobile Login and Marketplace Visibility Fix.md
nodes.rationale: All products had isMarketable false so the public marketplace filters intentionally excluded them; filters were left unchanged.

nodes.label: Better Auth session created after email OTP verification
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 OTP Profile Setup Redirect Fix.md
nodes.rationale: New accounts finished OTP without a usable session and hit inventory requests without authorization ('Could not load products').

nodes.label: Profile onboarding root-router guard
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-09-28 OTP Profile Setup Redirect Fix.md

nodes.label: GPS reverse geocoding for seller address suggestion
nodes.rationale: GPS previously returned coordinates only; pin stays set and manual entry is requested if geocoding has no result.

nodes.label: Removal of inventory_age_days, storage_temperature_c, storage_notes
nodes.rationale: Inputs could not be used reliably and created unsupported data paths and misleading seller guidance.

nodes.label: visibility-v4 scoring policy (40% posting age, 40% remaining quantity, 20% prior cycles)
web-ci.yml workflow (install, typecheck, build)
nodes.rationale: Catches dependency, TypeScript and production-build errors without deployment credentials.

nodes.label: GET /buyer/profile and POST /buyer/profile/avatar
nodes.rationale: Reuses the user.image field and existing S3 avatar convention with signed URLs so private buckets remain supported; accepts JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB.

nodes.label: Shared header profile image trigger with icon fallback
Agrivive Buyer UI Reference Research (delivery note)
Design dials (variance 6, motion 3, density 4) and palette
nodes.rationale: Calm editorial-commerce direction; forest green #1F4D3A primary, warm field #F8F6F1, terracotta reserved for attention; motion only for hierarchy and feedback.

nodes.label: ProductCard redesign (h-80 card, heart, split action stepper)
Orders page redesign (tabs, search, sort, status badges)
Seller map popup UI and accessibility overhaul
nodes.rationale: Removed Leaflet's blue link leak, raised targets to 44px and used plain words 'View stall' and 'N fresh items'.

nodes.label: Header active navigation derived from path and productType
Compact filter and card density follow-up
Fitts's Law touch-target guidance (44px/48px)
nodes.rationale: Paul Fitts and Luke Wroblewski: icon buttons at least 44px, primary CTAs at least 48px.

nodes.label: Buyer wishlist API (/buyer/wishlist)
nodes.rationale: The previous heart only toggled React state and reset on refresh; now persisted with a unique buyer/product index and cascading cleanup.

nodes.label: GET /marketplace/sellers/map
nodes.rationale: A dedicated seller-map query avoids tying map coverage to the product card cursor; unmappedSellerCount keeps sellers without coordinates visible as a limitation.

nodes.label: Leaflet interactive seller map with marker clustering
nodes.rationale: Lets buyers compare sellers spatially and move between a pin and the matching listing cards; OpenStreetMap tiles have no production SLA.

nodes.label: Spherical law of cosines distance (R = 6371 km, clamped)
nodes.rationale: Computed server-side and shared between product and map queries; client only displays returned distanceKm.

nodes.label: Next.js .next-dev cache removal
nodes.rationale: The tracked custom .next-dev directory raced with file generation on Windows causing missing build-manifest.json errors.

nodes.label: Buyer notice inbox with read and mark-all-read
Browser location filtering with shareable URL parameters
nodes.rationale: 5/10/25/50 km radius choices are initial product thresholds, not universal research constants; need later validation against buyer behavior.

nodes.label: Seller mobile order reporting with evidence upload
Leaflet marker images served from web/public/leaflet
nodes.rationale: Leaflet requested marker-icon-2x.png and marker-shadow.png from the site root producing 404s because Next.js does not expose node_modules images.

nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-10-06 Product Detail Full Screen UI.md

nodes.label: Wide product-detail layout with sticky purchase panel
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-10-06 Product Detail Full Screen UI.md
nodes.rationale: Previous layout left unused space and made the product image feel secondary; image is now the primary visual anchor.

nodes.label: Similar produce row (360px cards, 1120px cap, h-96 image)
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-10-06 Product Detail Full Screen UI.md
nodes.rationale: Width cap prevents wide grid tracks from spreading cards apart, following Gestalt Law of Proximity.

nodes.label: Order product image resolved in shared order-read utility
nodes.source_file: /home/jarajoaquinjara/projects/Agrivive/Agrivive/04 Delivery/2026-10-06 Product Detail Full Screen UI.md
nodes.rationale: One signed image URL source for order list and detail avoids per-card client product fetches.

nodes.label: FR-01 to FR-23 code-evidence register
nodes.rationale: A code-evidence register, not a functional-test pass sheet; an endpoint existing is not proof a scenario passed. FR-18 deferred; FR-23 partial by deliberate monitoring policy.

nodes.label: Non-functional requirements not marked passed
nodes.rationale: The proposal NFR table is absent; timing (3s/5s), device support and security targets are unmeasured pending owner evidence.
